code.description: Stable result code. effect_outcome_unknown is non-retryable. effect_replay_unsafe is non-retryable because an earlier non-idempotent effect already completed or was accepted before a later failure. effect_outcome_unknown_replay_safe permits retrying the complete Policy request with unchanged admitted idempotency keys and payload. The host never retries an effect within one request.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry; replay-safe unknown outcomes require the same complete request and idempotency keys.
